arStrings.szText: After casting a {c_important}Shout{/c} Skill, the active Cooldown of every other Non-{c_important}Shout{/c} Skill is reduced by {c_number}[SF_0|1|]{/c} seconds. If {c_important}Rallying Cry{/c} is used, reduce the Fury cost of the next {c_important}Core{/c} Skill by {c_number}[SF_1 * 100|%|]{/c} instead.
